title: Yosef Efrati
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Rabbi who served him and died before Rabbi, as in Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3. In the Babylonian Talmud there, 103a, he is called Shimon Efrati; perhaps he had two names.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Only the Babylonian Talmud is said here to call him Shimon Efrati. Having two names is Hyman’s suggestion.

Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3 names Yosef Efrati and Yoseh Cheifani among Rabbi’s attendants. Babylonian Ketubot 103a names Yosef Chofni and Shimon Efrati and says their biers preceded Rabbi’s. Hyman’s suggestion that Yosef Efrati had two names remains tentative; the comparison does not establish that identification or import a student relationship as an independent fact.
